repo_meta_data.description: A production-grade messaging abstraction for Go. It provides a unified API to decouple business logic from various brokers including Kafka, RabbitMQ, RocketMQ, NATS, Redis, and AWS SQS. Featuring built-in OpenTelemetry integration and engineered for high reliability.
